opening.argument: The presentation combines a downloadable trading bot, instructions to weaken security protections, and a direct profit pitch. Viewers are given a shortened download link, told to “Disable / remove antivirus (files are completely clean),” and instructed to configure a presale address, investment, gas, and gas limit before the bot submits the transaction. The promised upside is emphasized through claims of making “4 bnb in 3 hours,” recovering the application price in one trade, and turning 0.6 BNB into approximately 2.3 BNB. Those claims are especially unsupported because the speaker acknowledges, “I am still in testing phase when I make this video, so I am not sure it will work,” while the demonstration showed failed transactions. The evidence does not establish that anyone downloaded the bot, lost funds, or independently verified the displayed results.
